summary: Agree Realty Corp filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement on 2026-09-18 under an existing shelf registration (333-295307) covering common stock and guarantor subsidiary co-registrants including Agree Limited Partnership and various property LLCs. The excerpt contains only cover-page and filer-identification data, with no pricing, share count, deal terms, board recommendation, or advisor disclosed. Because this is an ordinary shelf takedown rather than a special situation, no deal terms are stated; watch the accompanying prospectus for the actual offering size and use of proceeds.
